column1: # dsh-os charset table - single source of truth for encoding names.
#   iana        canonical IANA name accepted on the command line (lower case; aliases resolved to these)
#   dotnet      [System.Text.Encoding] name or code page, as resolved by GetEncoding() on Windows PowerShell 5.1
#   bom         BOM bytes in hex, or '-' when the encoding has no BOM
#   fixed       yes when the encoding has exactly one byte order and no auto-detection is possible
# Verified on Windows PowerShell 5.1.19041.3031 / .NET Framework: every dotnet value below resolves.
# NOTE: System.Text.Encoding.CodePages does NOT exist on .NET Framework; do not use CodePagesEncodingProvider.
